title: How ordering works
intro: Ordering from Heiz Bags happens on WhatsApp, so you talk to a person, not a checkout.

steps.title: Choose your bag
steps.body: Browse the shop or try the Bag Finder. Add bags to your basket, or open the one you like.

steps.title: Send it on WhatsApp
steps.body: Tap Order on WhatsApp. Your message is written for you with the bag, the price and the link. Heiz Bags will reply to confirm availability.

steps.title: Pick up or delivery
steps.body: Collect your bag at our pick-up point in Dynamic Mall on Tom Mboya Street, or ask for delivery. Deliveries are done countrywide at a small fee.
